about.heading: About Me
about.body: Full-stack Software Engineer with experience building and deploying production systems using ASP.NET Core, React, TypeScript, and MySQL — backed by more than five years diagnosing AWS infrastructure in mission-critical environments. I design modular architectures with Domain-Driven Design, secure authentication, and cloud deployments on Railway for both personal and client projects. I'm currently completing a Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering with an emphasis on Software Development (expected March 2027), and I'm AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, looking for a role that combines software development with cloud expertise.

education.label: Education

awsSupportSpecialist.description: Served as an escalation point for high-severity incidents, diagnosing and resolving complex issues across EC2, S3, EBS, RDS, DynamoDB, VPC, and Route 53. Analyzed CloudWatch logs and system configurations to identify root causes of outages and performance degradation, reproducing issues in isolated test environments to validate fixes.

advancedTechnician.description: Acted as a subject matter expert supporting Tier 1 and Tier 2 associates on complex Amazon Echo and Alexa hardware, software, and connectivity issues, and served as the primary liaison between Hardware and Software teams to speed up cross-functional diagnostics.
